name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1808: Two fixes he asked for. The TZ_NOTABLE entry for the Act 5 ice cave claimed it was next door to the Act 2 tombs - different acts, different tilesets, a name-similarity slip - and TZ_NOTABLE is the one table that overrides density outright, so the zone was forced to PRIME on a relationship that does not exist. Removed from both tables and from the hint that printed the same claim on his card. And the workshop tab icons: v1683 mapped the six to ui_tab art and nothing ever read it, because the workshop row is a SIBLING of the tabs container and the icon pass only walked children. Both halves built, never joined.
